title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode1 Going Credit-Based

meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've made up my mind...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm going credit-based...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because I gave this decision a lot of thought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A lot of thought...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Minori?
Would you mind telling me more about what you did during that time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna hear too...
It'll be good for us to understand what your thought process was.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, sure...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After I spoke to you and Haruka, Airi, I...
A few days earlier
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Haruka said how going credit-based might lead to gaps forming between me and my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And Airi also experienced that.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I switch to the credit-based course and prioritize work, things could start getting awkward between me and my friends too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We wouldn't be in class together as much, and the same goes for committee stuff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess that's what Haruka meant when she said it's like switching to a completely different lifestyle...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And yeah, that might be kind of sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I have to be prepared to make some sacrifices if I want to do more as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As we keep receiving offers, there's bound to be lots that I'll absolutely want to accept.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't have the luxury of being a full-time student while working as a full-time idol...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...
Or can I have it both ways?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do I really need to choose one or the other...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What if I could find a way?
What if I worked really, really hard...? Would that make it possible...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
For example...
What if there was a way I could work more without going credit-based?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll try coming up with something!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If there really is a way for me to keep going to school and seeing my friends like normal, that'd be ideal...!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, this one too!
I can't get any of my ideas to work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I came up with so many methods...
Sprinting as fast as I can the moment classes end, leaving during lunch and coming back...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But shoots and meetings tend to be scheduled for when I'm supposed to be in class...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That makes sense, though... The people asking us to appear are also just working their normal hours during the week...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Which means there's no budging...
<Evening, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Len?!
But it's so late! What are you doing here?!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<The thing is...
I got the sense that you were struggling with something.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I knew I had to help, so here I am.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Wow, you're spot on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...
Len, are you some kind of psychic?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Haha. It makes it a little hard to tell you the real reason if you take me seriously like that.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <The truth is, I heard from Airi about what's going on. You're thinking about switching to the credit-based course, but aren't completely sure yet, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi told you...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. So, if there is something you wanna discuss, I'm here to help.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But listening is all I might be able to do since I don't know much about school and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I was just thinking I wanted somebody to hear me out, so it's really nice to hear you say that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right, Len.
This is about me switching to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's probably my best option in terms of being able to work more as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Airi and Haruka said how gaps or rifts may form between me and my friends if I do, which would be sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, I understand that I have to be willing to sacrifice certain things if I'm going to work more as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really don't want to have to make that choice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I was just putting together a schedule to see if I can still have it both ways!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay, now I see where you're at...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <After talking with Airi, I was wondering what kind of a solution you'd try to come up with...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I didn't imagine you were trying to find a way to be both a full-time student and idol. That sort of thinking does go along with your optimism, Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It does?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I couldn't figure out a good way in the end.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is there any way to reschedule those shoots and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I did consider that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But the last time someone rescheduled a meeting to the evening for us, the staff mentioned that it was outside of their regular hours...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I realized we were placing a burden on them. I really don't want to put anyone through that kind of trouble...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I had no idea...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, if that kind of thing continues...

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: So, it turns out that MORE MORE JUMP! is only going to be available when they don't have school. Their appearance on idol Hazard went pretty well too...

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line:
What?
Doesn't that mean they won't be able to be our on-site reporters for that shoot we discussed the other day?

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: That's correct, sir. They did however ask if we could reschedule to a later time...

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line: A later time? It's a special on trendy cafes for our female viewers, not hot dinner dates after dark!

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I'll have to reply by saying that it would change the feel of our program too much if we were to fulfill their request.

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line: I know that most of them have experience being idols, but it's still too soon for them to be asking us to reschedule like this. They can start throwing their weight around once they've become as popular as ASRUN used to be...

rows.Speaker: Important Person
rows.Line:
For now, stop sending them any offers.
In fact, blacklist them.

rows.Speaker: Staff Person
rows.Line: Understood! I'll also let the president know that we are to stop asking them to appear any further!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if something like that happens?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I-Is that really possible?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I do understand not wanting to cause your business partners any trouble. And it'd be terrible if they stopped making you offers because of something you did.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know...
Which is why rescheduling is gonna be really tough.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that also means having to choose between school and work. So, if I want to keep pursuing our dream, I should probably switch to the credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But unlike Airi and the others, I don't think I'm clearly seeing all the pros and cons...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Then, let's try to get a clearer look!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Minori, you just said that you tried to come up with a schedule that lets you be a normal student while you work.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, why not next try coming up with one for after you've switched to the credit-based course?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If you look at things from that perspective, you might start to see how much time you'll be spending at school versus how much you'll be working...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That could help you figure out the pros and cons of this system.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's genius...!
I should try that before jumping to any conclusions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll give your idea a try.
This version can be called, Minori Hanasato: Full-Time Idol!
